annotations.title: Send a quote request (confirmed by the customer by e-mail)

description: Send a quote request (demande de devis) to SYMONE for the customer, for any route and date, including routes not listed by search_routes. Nothing is recorded until the customer confirms: SYMONE e-mails them a link (valid 48 h) to check the request, accept the terms and confirm. The quote then arrives by e-mail (minutes for common routes, otherwise within one business day). No payment. Ask the customer before sending their name, e-mail and phone. Returns the request id, its status and the cities as SYMONE understood them; fix the listed fields if the request is refused.

comment.description: Anything useful for the SYMONE team.

customer.description: The customer the quote is for. The confirmation e-mail goes to this address.

civility.description: Optional, only if the customer gave it: M (Monsieur), F (Madame) or X (none). Never guess it from the first name.

departure_city.description: Where the motorcycles are picked up, e.g. 'Paris 15e', 'Marseille', '93200 Saint-Denis' or 'Barcelona, Spain'.

departure_date.description: Wanted date YYYY-MM-DD, or a period in words ('mid-December', 'between 10 and 15 March').

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key (e.g. a UUID): a retried call with the same key never sends a second e-mail.

motorcycles.description: One entry per motorcycle (scooters, trikes and side-cars included).

details.description: Optional: not running, side-car, top case, accessories…

model.description: Make and model, e.g. 'BMW R 1250 GS', 'Yamaha TMAX 560'.

paris_details.description: Required when Paris is the departure or arrival: arrondissement, nearby town or flexibility ('15e', 'Boulogne-Billancourt', 'flexible').

return.description: Required when trip_type is round_trip. Cities default to the outbound trip reversed; motorcycles and riders default to the outbound ones.

details.description: Optional: not running, side-car, top case, accessories…

model.description: Make and model, e.g. 'BMW R 1250 GS', 'Yamaha TMAX 560'.

riders.description: People travelling with the motorcycles (motorcycle + rider service). 0 = motorcycles only.
